reviews.title: Great case when on sale, ARGB hub does not work with motherboard or software controls.
reviews.comment: I got this on sale, $49.99.  At that price it's a solid choice if you're experienced with building your own machines cause the instructions are absolutely garbage.  I also can not for the life of me get the included ARGB hub to work with any motherboard or software package so you're stuck with the pre-programmed options that you cycle through with that super tiny front button (but there are A LOT of options). Fans are whisper quiet at low RPMs, the LEDs are bright and the case itself seems solid, even when you remove that corner pillar.
reviews.author: Jason
